text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa――

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: (Dammit...!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: (My senses are dull... my vision is warping...! I can't even tell how fast I'm running...!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Haa, ngh...! Haa, haa...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(Am I winning right now...!?
Or am I—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... haaah...
*gasp*... haaah... haaah...—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(It feels like... weights are attached
all over my body...——)

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what happened to Bubble-chan...?
Could she be... injured—

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text: I don't know. I don't know, but still...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hey... didn't Bubble Gum Fellow's
running look a bit off today...?
And she's still acting weird right now, isn't she...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Is she not feeling well?
I'm kinda worried, will she be okay...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Sol Lapis was the favorite in her last dirt debut but only finished 3rd...
And Waltz just recently retired due to injury, too--

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
"Is the 'Four Heavenly Kings' thing in trouble?
I'm getting a little worried about how things'll go..."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Aah... damn it...—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(Why is it that the only things I don't want to hear...
are the ones that come through so crystal clear...――)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(My run today... made everyone... anxious...
Even though I intended to pave the way to a brighter future—)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: This wasn't supposed to...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I ran out to greet Bubble Gum Fellow, who was clearly acting off.
At first glance, her gait appeared normal.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I want you to answer honestly.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: How was... my running today?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Deep down, she probably already knows the answer.
Even so, she chose to ask me."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Taking that meaning to heart... as her Trainer, I put it into words.
choice_data_list: ......That wasn't the same running as before.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Regardless of the result, her running today
was clearly... on a whole different level compared to before.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't a powerful stride that broke open possibilities and fueled dreams...
It was a run that looked like someone struggling amidst agony――

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
“......Thank you.
For telling me the truth.”

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: …………What am I even doing, really.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Running by my own choice, full of drive,
pushing through despite the strain...—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I ended up making everyone... anxious instead...
Wondering, 'Is she really going to be okay from now on?'—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"The dream that was supposed to swell...
That momentum... With my own hands, I...—"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ――I'm sorry, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...I can't be with you right now.
...I don't want to hurt you.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, I probably...
can't act like my usual self, so—"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"I'll get back in shape by tomorrow's checkup.
...So please—"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...I couldn't chase after Bubble Gum Fellow as he ran off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She must be the one most confused right now.
And... the one filled with the most regret."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That I couldn't run true to myself...
and couldn't let my dreams swell
the way I always have.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That is why she needs some time alone right now
to collect herself..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...This is just a justification to protect myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At a loss for words to say to Bubble Gum Fellow,
it was a cowardly lie to hide my own inadequacy.
choice_data_list: (What I really need to do... is something else!)
(There's something else... that I need to do!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I pull out the bubble gum I always keep
in my pocket just for Bubble Gum Fellow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"You put it in your mouth and chew.
...And then, you blow a bubble."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Anger at my own incompetence.
A sense of duty as a Trainer.
And my feelings for Bubble Gum Fellow.
choice_data_list: (I can do it... I can do it... I can do it...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Along with a popping sound,
my vision and thoughts became crystal clear—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...What I must do right now as her Trainer.
That is to do everything in my power so Bubble Gum Fellow can run like herself once more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What she needs right now is a strong will to confront the hardships ahead and reclaim her running form. A motivation—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pulling out the smartphone, I try to reach out.
The recipients are those whom Bubble Gum Fellow wished to inspire with his running today—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In turn, they were also the ones who could
reignite that fierce fighting spirit in Bubble Gum Fellow once more.

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
"—Bubble's Trainer? What's wrong?
Did something happen to Bubble after all—"
choice_data_list: ...I've got something to talk to the Heavenly Kings about.
...I have something to tell all of you in the Heavenly Kings.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Let's clear it away.
The dark cloud hanging over
Bubble Gum Fellow—
